text: Better is one’s own duty (though) destitute of merits, than the duty of another well performed. He who does the duty ordained by his own nature incurs no sin. BHAGAVAD GITA Sahajam karma kaunteya sadoshamapi na tyajet; Sarvaarambhaa hi doshena dhoomenaagnirivaavritaah.

chapter_title: The Yoga of Liberation by Renunciation
text: One should not abandon, O Arjuna, the duty to which one is born, though faulty; for, all undertakings are enveloped by evil, as fire by smoke! Asaktabuddhih sarvatra jitaatmaa vigatasprihah; Naishkarmyasiddhim paramaam sannyaasenaadhigacchati.

chapter_title: The Yoga of Liberation by Renunciation
text: He whose intellect is unattached everywhere, who has subdued his self, from whom desire has fled,—he by renunciation attains the supreme state of freedom from action. Siddhim praapto yathaa brahma tathaapnoti nibodha me; Samaasenaiva kaunteya nishthaa jnaanasya yaa paraa.

chapter_title: The Yoga of Liberation by Renunciation
text: Learn from Me in brief, O Arjuna, how he who has attained perfection reaches Brahman, that supreme state of knowledge. Buddhyaa vishuddhayaa yukto dhrityaatmaanam niyamya cha; Shabdaadeen vishayaanstyaktwaa raagadweshau vyudasya cha.

chapter_title: The Yoga of Liberation by Renunciation
text: Endowed with a pure intellect, controlling the self by firmness, relinquishing sound and other objects and abandoning both hatred and attraction, Viviktasevee laghwaashee yatavaakkaayamaanasah; Dhyaanayogaparo nityam vairaagyam samupaashritah.

chapter_title: The Yoga of Liberation by Renunciation
text: Dwelling in solitude, eating but little, with speech, body and mind subdued, always engaged in concentration and meditation, taking refuge in dispassion, Ahankaaram balam darpam kaamam krodham parigraham; Vimuchya nirmamah shaanto brahmabhooyaaya kalpate.

chapter_title: The Yoga of Liberation by Renunciation
text: Having abandoned egoism, strength, arrogance, anger, desire, and covetousness, free from the notion of “mine” and peaceful,—he is fit for becoming Brahman. Brahmabhootah prasannaatmaa na shochati na kaangkshati; Samah sarveshu bhooteshu madbhaktim labhate paraam.

chapter_title: The Yoga of Liberation by Renunciation
text: Becoming Brahman, serene in the Self, he neither grieves nor desires; the same to all beings, he attains supreme devotion unto Me. Bhaktyaa maamabhijaanaati yaavaanyashchaasmi tattwatah; Tato maam tattwato jnaatwaa vishate tadanantaram.

chapter_title: The Yoga of Liberation by Renunciation
text: By devotion he knows Me in truth, what and who I am; and knowing Me in truth, he forthwith enters into the Supreme. Sarvakarmaanyapi sadaa kurvaano madvyapaashrayah; Matprasaadaadavaapnoti shaashwatam padamavyayam.

chapter_title: The Yoga of Liberation by Renunciation
text: Doing all actions always, taking refuge in Me, by My Grace he obtains the eternal, indestructible state or abode. Chetasaa sarvakarmaani mayi sannyasya matparah; Buddhiyogam upaashritya macchittah satatam bhava.

chapter_title: The Yoga of Liberation by Renunciation
text: Mentally renouncing all actions in Me, having Me as the highest goal, resorting to the Yoga of discrimination do thou ever fix thy mind on Me. Macchittah sarvadurgaani matprasaadaat tarishyasi; Atha chet twam ahankaaraan na shroshyasi vinangkshyasi.

chapter_title: The Yoga of Liberation by Renunciation
text: Fixing thy mind on Me, thou shalt by My Grace overcome all obstacles; but if from egoism thou wilt not hear Me, thou shalt perish. Yadahankaaram aashritya na yotsya iti manyase; Mithyaisha vyavasaayaste prakritistwaam niyokshyati.

chapter_title: The Yoga of Liberation by Renunciation
text: If, filled with egoism, thou thinkest: “I will not fight”, vain is this, thy resolve; Nature will compel thee. Swabhaavajena kaunteya nibaddhah swena karmanaa; Kartum necchasi yanmohaat karishyasyavasho’pi tat.

chapter_title: The Yoga of Liberation by Renunciation
text: O Arjuna, bound by thy own Karma (action) born of thy own nature, that which from delusion thou wishest not to do, even that thou shalt do helplessly! COMMENTARY: Thou wilt be forced to fight because of thy nature. It will compel thee to fight, much against thy will. Eeshwarah sarvabhootaanaam hriddeshe’rjuna tishthati; Bhraamayan sarvabhootaani yantraaroodhaani maayayaa.

chapter_title: The Yoga of Liberation by Renunciation
text: The Lord dwells in the hearts of all beings, O Arjuna, causing all beings, by His illusive power, to revolve as if mounted on a machine! Tameva sharanam gaccha sarvabhaavena bhaarata; Tatprasaadaatparaam shaantim sthaanam praapsyasi shaashwatam. BHAGAVAD GITA

chapter_title: The Yoga of Liberation by Renunciation
text: Fly unto Him for refuge with all thy being, O Arjuna! By His Grace thou shalt obtain supreme peace and the eternal abode. Iti te jnaanamaakhyaatam guhyaad guhyataram mayaa; Vimrishyaitadasheshena yathecchasi tathaa kuru.

chapter_title: The Yoga of Liberation by Renunciation
text: Thus has wisdom more secret than secrecy itself been declared unto thee by Me; having reflected over it fully, then act thou as thou wishest. Sarvaguhyatamam bhooyah shrinu me paramam vachah; Ishto’si me dridhamiti tato vakshyaami te hitam.

chapter_title: The Yoga of Liberation by Renunciation
text: Hear thou again My supreme word, most secret of all; because thou art dearly beloved of Me, I will tell thee what is good. Manmanaa bhava madbhakto madyaajee maam namaskuru; Maamevaishyasi satyam te pratijaane priyo’si me.

chapter_title: The Yoga of Liberation by Renunciation
text: Fix thy mind on Me, be devoted to Me, sacrifice to Me, bow down to Me. Thou shalt come even to Me; truly do I promise unto thee, (for) thou art dear to Me. Sarvadharmaan parityajya maamekam sharanam vraja; Aham twaa sarvapaapebhyo mokshayishyaami maa shuchah.

chapter_title: The Yoga of Liberation by Renunciation
text: Abandoning all duties, take refuge in Me alone; I will liberate thee from all sins; grieve not. Idam te naatapaskaaya naabhaktaaya kadaachana; Na chaashushrooshave vaachyam na cha maam yo’bhyasooyati.

chapter_title: The Yoga of Liberation by Renunciation
text: This is never to be spoken by thee to one who is devoid of austerities, to one who is not devoted, nor to one who does not render service, nor who does not desire to listen, nor to one who cavils at Me. Ya imam paramam guhyam madbhakteshvabhidhaasyati; Bhaktim mayi paraam kritwaa maamevaishyatyasamshayah.

chapter_title: The Yoga of Liberation by Renunciation
text: He who with supreme devotion to Me will teach this supreme secret to My devotees, shall doubtless come to Me. Na cha tasmaanmanushyeshu kashchinme priyakrittamah; Bhavitaa na cha me tasmaadanyah priyataro bhuvi.

chapter_title: The Yoga of Liberation by Renunciation
text: Nor is there any among men who does dearer service to Me, nor shall there be another on earth dearer to Me than he.

chapter_title: The Yoga of Liberation by Renunciation
text: And he who will study this sacred dialogue of ours, by him I shall have been worshipped by the sacrifice of wisdom; such is My conviction. Shraddhaavaan anasooyashcha shrinuyaadapi yo narah; So’pi muktah shubhaamllokaan praapnuyaat punyakarmanaam.

chapter_title: The Yoga of Liberation by Renunciation
text: The man also who hears this, full of faith and free from malice, he, too, liberated, shall attain to the happy worlds of those of righteous deeds. Kacchid etacchrutam paartha twayaikaagrena chetasaa; Kacchid ajnaanasammohah pranashtaste dhananjaya.

chapter_title: The Yoga of Liberation by Renunciation
speaker: Arjuna
text: Has this been heard, O Arjuna, with one-pointed mind? Has the delusion of thy ignorance been fully destroyed, O Dhananjaya? Nashto mohah smritirlabdhaa twatprasaadaanmayaachyuta; Sthito’smi gata sandehah karishye vachanam tava.

chapter_title: The Yoga of Liberation by Renunciation
speaker: Sanjaya
text: Destroyed is my delusion as I have gained my memory (knowledge) through Thy Grace, O Krishna! I am firm; my doubts are gone. I will act according to Thy word. Ityaham vaasudevasya paarthasya cha mahaatmanah; Samvaadam imam ashrausham adbhutam romaharshanam.

chapter_title: The Yoga of Liberation by Renunciation
speaker: Sanjaya
text: Thus have I heard this wonderful dialogue between Krishna and the high-souled Arjuna, which causes the hair to stand on end. Vyaasaprasaadaacchrutavaan etadguhyamaham param; Yogam yogeshwaraat krishnaat saakshaat kathayatah swayam.

chapter_title: The Yoga of Liberation by Renunciation
speaker: Sanjaya
text: Through the Grace of Vyasa I have heard this supreme and most secret Yoga direct from Krishna, the Lord of Yoga Himself declaring it. BHAGAVAD GITA Raajan samsmritya samsmritya samvaadam imam adbhutam; Keshavaarjunayoh punyam hrishyaami cha muhurmuhuh.

chapter_title: The Yoga of Liberation by Renunciation
speaker: Sanjaya
text: O King, remembering this wonderful and holy dialogue between Krishna and Arjuna, I rejoice again and again! Taccha samsmritya samsmritya roopamatyadbhutam hareh; Vismayo me mahaan raajan hrishyaami cha punah punah.

chapter_title: The Yoga of Liberation by Renunciation
speaker: Sanjaya
text: And remembering again and again also that most wonderful form of Hari, great is my wonder, O King! And I rejoice again and again! Yatra yogeshwarah krishno yatra paartho dhanurdharah; Tatra shreervijayo bhootirdhruvaa neetirmatirmama.

chapter_title: The Yoga of Liberation by Renunciation
speaker: Sanjaya
text: Wherever there is Krishna, the Lord of Yoga, wherever there is Arjuna, the archer, there are prosperity, happiness, victory and firm policy; such is my conviction. Hari Om Tat Sat Iti Srimad Bhagavadgeetaasoopanishatsu Brahmavidyaayaam Yogashaastre Sri Krishnaarjunasamvaade Mokshasannyaasayogo Naama Ashtaadasho’dhyaayah Thus in the Upanishads of the glorious Bhagavad Gita, the science of the Eternal, the scripture of Yoga, the dialogue between Sri Krishna and Arjuna, ends the eighteenth discourse entitled: “The Yoga of Liberation by Renunciation” Om Shanti! Shanti! Shanti!
